selection.rationale: This found-status mainland purchase-route attempt is attached to an active published variant. Its latest CNY 4,999 record is only a public-market report and the current official-flagship marketplace listing may establish a selected-build checkout or may remain generic; a bounded exact-page recheck can determine whether a safe current price observation closes the live gap.

targets.model: PARDUS Super Sport Gen2 L-TWOO eGR

research_route.action: Read-only audit of the exact variant, current price, source and attempt; open the one recorded official-flagship Taobao item page once.
research_route.integration_rule: A new dated CNY price record may be added only if the page visibly identifies the exact L-TWOO eGR build, current amount/discount conditions, and an available stock or add-to-cart state. Keep the prior price observation. If seller identity, selected build, price or availability is inaccessible or ambiguous, add a source-reuse resolution with the exact limitation and leave the price/gap unchanged.
boundaries: One exact model and one atomic gap only.
Do not login, challenge-bypass, contact sellers, or retry the page if it blocks access.
Do not infer exact eGR stock, CNY checkout, invoice, shipping or domestic warranty from a generic Super Sport Gen2 result.
Do not change recommendation, image, component facts, or publication status.
